scenes.name: Title
scenes.vo_text: The transaction is not the crime. The network is. Suspicious activity hides in the hops around a payment, not in the wire itself. Corridor Watch takes the network as the case. One synthetic case shows the path.
scenes.headline: The transaction is not the crime.
scenes.camera: slow push; graph blooms after thesis exits

scenes.name: Problem
scenes.vo_text: A rule on one transaction flags the wrong object. Cross-border mule and layering rings are not a single wire. Funds can arrive, rest for minutes, and leave under another purpose. A threshold cannot see that shared device. The bank is left an alert, and no memory of the network.
scenes.headline: An alert with no network memory
scenes.hero: Isolated alert card + ghost unknowns → 3 institutions · 3 accounts · 1 device
scenes.camera: amber ring on alert; resolve network

scenes.name: What it is
scenes.vo_text: This console is the middle bank, BANK_SG. Case CW-MID-02 is $9,050, Singapore to the Philippines, risk 91, mule pass-through. Queue partial. Visibility is coverage, not guilt. CW-MID-01 / D-MID-MULE. The object under review is the corridor.
scenes.headline: Ranked by risk · 91
scenes.hero: Real Investigations UI — select CW-MID-02, then queue CW-MID-01 on feeder VO
scenes.camera: device frame 80% width; cursor to CW-MID-02; punch-ins on 91/visibility; cut to CW-MID-01 queue @ feeder VO

scenes.name: Features / evidence
scenes.vo_text: Corridor Watch constructs that corridor before a model speaks. Ingest never calls Gemini. 12-step DAG → evidence pack → deterministic verdict. Pill high · 91. Next step is a human decision, not an automatic clear.
scenes.headline: Built deterministically
scenes.camera: rows → tiles; bars fill on VO nouns

scenes.name: Features / corridor
scenes.vo_text: Downstream of the Philippines hop the graph keeps an unknown boundary. It does not invent a bank.
scenes.headline: Follow the money across institutions
scenes.hero: One corridor graph only (native or capture — never double)
scenes.camera: glide along path; unknown hop dashed

scenes.name: How Gemini helps
scenes.vo_text: Gemini does not see the raw ledger… Force Gemini explains only the pack… pause for FIU lead… provenance / gate fail… deterministic verdict stands. Evidence chips cite the pack.
scenes.headline: The model cannot override the evidence
scenes.hero: AI brief + pipeline + designed gate-fail claim
scenes.camera: pipeline stages light with VO; reject flash; HIGH·91 lock
scenes.on_screen_vendor: AI / the model (SHOW_VENDOR_NAME=false); VO may say Gemini

scenes.name: Governance
scenes.vo_text: Consequential actions stay with the FIU lead. Hold payment / escalate / freeze refused for analyst. Lead records hold payment. Human authorization — not a core-banking freeze. Gemini recommended. A person decided.
scenes.headline: Recommendation is not authorization
scenes.hero: Two large cards + AUTHORIZED stamp + clean audit row
scenes.camera: card1 → line → card2; stamp; audit row

scenes.name: Memory
scenes.vo_text: Confirming decision writes Crime Pattern DNA. Multi-hop layering fingerprint. Reusable memory. Next network can match. Library holds the pattern. The single wire does not.
scenes.headline: Every confirmed case strengthens the next one
scenes.hero: Pattern DNA library → CW-005 card ≥40% frame
scenes.camera: shared-element zoom; match glow; matches count-up

scenes.name: Close
scenes.vo_text: The transaction is not the crime. The network is. Corridor Watch turns investigations into institutional memory.
scenes.headline: Investigate the corridor. Preserve the evidence. Keep the decision human.
scenes.hero: Logo + CTA + URL placeholder + Synthetic demo data
